rules.instruction: Build a versioned Offer Context Map before searching: observable situation, current problem, desired outcome, failed approaches, exclusions, and later-stage commercial criteria.

Search problem, failed-attempt, stakes, desired-outcome, then workaround or objection language. Inspect five results per query and stop after one qualified candidate, ten rewrites, or fifty sampled results without weakening the gates.
Public-reply eligibility requires a concrete current first-person problem plus at least one failed attempt, meaningful stake, or genuine request for help.
Qualify from authored situation and desired-outcome evidence. Solution awareness is informational; profile labels can support but cannot establish fit.
Inspect the full post, visible replies, profile, and relevant recent content. Reject stale, duplicate, suppressed, contradictory, teacher, advice, recycled-hook, or seller-funnel false positives.
Route genuine off-offer pain to adjacent research with the rejection reason and Offer Context version; never add it to the active Buyer Language Bank.
Run hard gates before scoring. Scores rank eligible candidates and control later stages; they cannot qualify or disqualify a public reply.
The first public reply must contain no offer, link, DM ask, call ask, or paid ask.

With clear context, acknowledge the exact signal, explain one mechanism, give one practical next move, and state the honest tradeoff without forcing a question. Use A-C-A and exactly one useful question only when evidence is genuinely missing.
Use lived experience only when the owner has approved it as true. Personal diction remains in local Voice Context and never becomes a universal rule.
Agents may research, reject, rank, draft, pre-fill, log, and learn. The owner alone clicks Send, grants DM permission, approves calls or offers, and authorizes account changes.
Learn from qualified progression within seventy-two hours, not likes or generic thanks. Owner edits update message policy only and never retroactively change candidate qualification.

Safety or correctness defects may create an immediate tested proposal. Soft rules require ten comparable outcomes; twenty outcomes across two passing batches mark promotion recommended. No public rule changes until the owner merges a redacted tested release PR.
